queries.query: Audit the changed React and Tailwind checkout UI for raw colors and repeated spacing. Reuse existing semantic theme roles where appropriate, decide whether any missing values deserve global or scoped tokens, and leave true one-off layout values local.

Our alert banners repeat raw color, radius, shadow, and transition values across three surfaces. Propose semantic token names and update the styling without introducing color-named or pixel-named global tokens.
Refactor three nearly identical React buttons into one accessible Button component with size, loading, icon, and destructive variants while preserving the existing styles.
Review this modal for focus trapping, Escape handling, focus restoration, label associations, and screen-reader announcements, then fix the accessibility issues.
